own_solution.law: Energy conservation gives mw*c*(Ti-Tf)=mi*Lf+mi*c*Tf. With Lf=334000 J/kg, Tf=23.4773 K above melting and Qlost=34.582068966 kJ. Heating the original water by q changes Ti to 40+q and gives Qlost(q)=34.582068966+0.288689655*q kJ.
assumptions: The stated specific heat capacity is constant and applies to the original water and melted ice.
Any specified heater operation finishes before the ice is added.
The stated 40 K temperature excess describes the original water before heater operation.
The second container and an earlier completed run exchange no energy with the current mixture.
